title: Exempt the PR #14 squash 5a73478 from the history check
summary: The history check fails on 5a73478 because the squash of #14 bundles several jobs' landings. The repo's precedent (#8, #9) is to add the commit's full id to [history].exempt in athena.toml with an explanatory comment. I read the request that way, assuming the cause is the same landing-check shape.

defaults_applied.how: Recovered the fix from the repository's existing exempt-list precedent instead of asking.
One focused change to the exempt list.
Verifier runs cargo test, clippy and fmt --check.
Only a commit id and a comment are added, no personal data.
The comment explains the exemption for an outside reader.

assumptions: The failure is the same landing-check shape as the earlier exempted squashes (#8, #9), not a real violation such as a secret or personal-data leak.
The fix is an exemption, not a change to the check code.
The producer can resolve the full id of 5a73478 with git log or git show.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml [history].exempt gains the full 40-character id of the commit abbreviated 5a73478, resolved with git log/show, and keeps the four existing entries.
A comment beside the entry says it is the squash of PR #14 and why the check refuses it, citing the precedent of #8/#9 (D66/D70).
Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`; both pass, including the config parsing tests. Run `cargo fmt --check`.
Only governance file athena.toml is changed among governance files, and records/ is untouched.

out_of_scope: Changing the history check logic in crates/athena-gate
departures: Slightly lower acceptance and pass rates than the reference. I could not run git or see the history check's output, so the real failure cause is unconfirmed, and the full commit id has to be resolved by the producer.
